purpose: Adversarially audit only the frozen validated Codex result, waiver-aware comparison and synthesis plan without acquiring new research facts.
post_audit_holds: Claude and Grok absence remains visible and confidence remains medium.
Payroll execution and compensation results remain in one aggregate only while compensation plans, agreements, equity administration and non-payroll rewards stay external or future model candidates.
The WM-ORG-005 parent signal and every neighboring edge remain provisional rather than canonical.
Payroll run, payee result, compensation term, input record, payment, statement, filing, remittance, ledger entry, dispute and records object remain separate identities.
Regular, supplemental, off-cycle, final, advance, retroactive, correction, reversal and void processing remain explicit classes.
Gross, statutory bases, deductions, employer contributions, net pay, employer cost and labour cost do not prove one another.
Calculated, validated, approved, released, paid, settled, filed, accepted, reconciled and closed states do not prove one another.
Every external projection remains jurisdiction-scoped, release-pinned and loss-declaring.
audit_findings: The aggregate preserves separate payroll-run and payee-result identities and does not turn compensation planning into payroll execution.
The model does not absorb worker, engagement, job, timekeeping, leave, expense, performance, benefit, tax, payment, ledger, filing, dispute or records masters.
Compensation terms, source inputs, calculation rules, intermediate results and final values remain separately sourced and versioned.
Amount assertions preserve type, currency, unit, period, rule version, precision, derivation and external-master references.
Net pay is not treated as proof of payment instruction, execution, settlement or worker receipt, and filing submission is not authority acceptance.
Corrections, reversals and voids preserve original calculations and declare downstream impacts rather than erasing history.
Autonomous compensation change, calculation override, approval, payment, filing, disclosure and destruction remain prohibited.
No unresolved critical semantic conflict prevents reviewable-draft publication.
